title: Board of Water Supply opposes Bill 1
summary: The Board of Water Supply voted, five ayes, to tell Council Member Cook's office it does not support Bill 1, after testifiers said the water department should keep its discretion. The bill would let the department review subdivision construction plans before water is verified, at the developer's risk. The committee had deferred it in August so the board could comment.

timeline.text: The motion passed with five ayes.
A motion was made to tell Council Member Cook's office the board does not support Bill 1.
Another testifier opposed the Bill 1 amendment, saying the water department should keep its discretion.
Members who plan to draft a response should say so to learn the deadline.
A council member's letter about the board's further comments on Bill 1 will be on the next meeting's agenda.
The bill goes back to the Board of Water Supply for comments before the committee takes it up again.
